value.rationale: Observation of a terminal location but not an event time is a natural latent-duration inference problem. The sign-dependent base laws and common explicitly positive spatial compound-Poisson kernel yield an exact coupling of an uncountable continuum of posteriors, strict stochastic ordering along each ray and affine conditional mean/variance, overcoming opacity of existing fixed-time Bessel density formulas. This is a structural property of a genuinely asymmetric family, not an arbitrary finite numerical slice.
